Description: Delegate real work to Copilot, such as creating or updating records or running actions in Business Central.
GettingStartedSteps: Ensure your tenant has an eligible Microsoft 365 subscription, Microsoft Copilot is enabled in Business Central, and you have a Business Central Essentials or Premium license. A Microsoft Copilot license is not required, but is highly recommended.
To get started, open the Copilot pane and type your task to Copilot: it can create, edit or delete records, and use actions on pages, including fields and objects from your extensions.
For example, ask Copilot to create a new Purchase Order from a demo Vendor and for some demo Items.
Changes are saved immediately, and Copilot will summarize what it changed in the Copilot pane.
Use Send feedback in the Copilot menu or the thumbs-up or thumbs-down controls to share feedback.
